title: DLSA Dima Hasao Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 20 Para Legal Volunteer Posts
description: The District Legal Services Authority (DLSA Dima Hasao) has announced the official notification for the recruitment of 20 Para Legal Volunteer posts. Candidates who have qualified in the 10th Pass can grab this chance and apply for the DLSA Dima Hasao Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
